accounts.name: Vertex Compute
accounts.narrative: CTO and key champion Alex Rivera departed in Jan 2026. New CTO favors competitor cloud. GPU utilization crashed from 82% to 41%. No executive contact in 90+ days.

key_signals.description: CTO Alex Rivera resigned. Priya Sharma promoted as interim.
GPU utilization crashed from 82% to 41% over 4 weeks.
New CTO evaluating AWS and CoreWeave. RFP issued.
No executive contact in 90+ days. QBR requests unanswered.

signals.description: Senior CSM Sarah Chen assigned with executive mandate to save the account.
GPU utilization recovering: 41% → 68% after PB-03 optimization playbook.
New CTO Priya Sharma re-engaged after product roadmap preview.

outcomes.description: ARR protected through dedicated CSM and optimization playbook.

accounts.narrative: Sev-1 outage in Pod 3 took down 40% of production workloads for 6 hours. MTBF dropped below SLA. Executive escalation to CEO.

key_signals.description: Sev-1: Complete rack failure in Pod 3. 6-hour production outage.
CEO called our VP of Sales directly. Demanding root cause within 48 hours.
Workload migration to backup DC started. 30% capacity shift.

signals.description: VP of Customer Success personally assigned as exec sponsor.
System uptime restored to 99.95% after infrastructure overhaul.

outcomes.description: Retention plan approved with 18-month commitment and SLA credits.
Full renewal secured after infrastructure overhaul demonstration.
